title: RpaBlockly adapter event duplicate acceptance proof and semantic API subset

result.assertion: The actual installed-package consumer subscribes through RpaBlockly Browser.Context and SDK IBrowserContext.Page; each actual event is observed exactly once, event args match returned/collection objects, and adapter unsubscribe/resubscribe does not accumulate callbacks.

eventAssertions.route: RpaBlockly BrowserLauncher.LaunchAsync -> BrowserSession.Browser (SpyBrowserSessionBrowser.Context) -> BrowserSession.NewContextAsync -> SDK wrapped context
eventAssertions.source: D:/RpaBlockly/src/RpaFlow.Playwright/Core/BrowserLauncher.cs at pinned c2f2947c3ccd8b20f7a1cdf9c3b41fb68567b6ca: SpyBrowserSessionBrowser.NewContextAsync awaits handle.NewContextAsync then Track; Track guards duplicate context entries, captures _context under lock, and invokes handler once when context is not closed.
eventAssertions.consumerAssertion: Program.cs: contextCallbacks == 1 and ReferenceEquals(callbackContext, firstEventContext); after removing/re-adding the same handler, contextCallbacks == 2 for the next distinct context, with callbackContext reference-identical to the returned context.

eventAssertions.route: returned SDK-prepared IBrowserContext.Page event -> RpaBlockly context.NewPageAsync -> context.Pages
eventAssertions.source: SpyBrowser PlaywrightHumanizer event proxy adapts supported event add/remove handlers, wraps event arguments and caches wrappers; pinned RpaBlockly BrowserSession returns the same context passed to the consumer.
eventAssertions.consumerAssertion: Program.cs: subscribe before context.NewPageAsync; pageCallbacks == 1 and callbackPage is reference-identical to wrappedPage and context.Pages.Single().

result.scope: Concrete actual Chromium consumer assertion for these two event routes only; not a claim about every Playwright event, every adapter/version, or arbitrary re-entrant/concurrent subscription schedule.
result.baseline: Prior recovery-input-closure.json literal 13.11 explicitly remained partial because aggregate 13/13 and SDK-only context identity were not an isolated RpaBlockly adapter duplicate-callback assertion. This proof adds that missing actual-consumer counter case.
